card: Name: Shabda-Oud Witches
ALIAS: The Three Whore-Priestesses; Lady Ambassadors; reverend mothers; the witches; The Elders; The Four Whore-Priestesses of Shabda-Oud
ROLE: Order members at the rank of witch, priestess, or reverend mother within the Shabda-Oud hierarchy; distinct from and subordinate to the Mother Superior office
ROLE: Function as diplomatic emissaries, psychic enforcers, reproductive operatives, and covert commandos depending on mission context
TRAIT: Act collectively; pool psychic force for joint mental attacks rather than fighting as individuals
TRAIT: Hierarchical structure: common members, reverend mothers, Elders; each tier holds distinct authority and power reserves
TRAIT: Ordinary members' psychic power is entirely dependent on Jejoh's brainwaves; his destruction collapses them catastrophically as a fighting force
TRAIT: The Elders retain limited independent psychic reserves not reliant on Jejoh; described as finite and expendable in a final assault

TRAIT: Operate from a lair carved from an ice asteroid in deep space; entry controlled by a delta-psychic force-switch with multi-layer biological, brainwave, and infra-conscious identity verification
TRAIT: Create and deploy cetacyborg creatures as military assets
TRAIT: Possess advanced psycho-surgical science; associated with heart-bomb implantation in targets
TRAIT: Intrusion detection uses brainwave and genetic probe systems that flag anomalous signatures
TRAIT: Received ceremonially as prophets of Jejoh at allied fortresses; conduct formal Hall of Arms examinations including alpha-mode brain-state detection and killer-programming screening
TRAIT: Calculate speech as a strategic weapon; issue threats aloud on monitored channels to warn potential betrayers before they can act
TRAIT: In the Aghnar era, governed by a twelve-generation breeding plan to produce the prophesied hermaphrodite Sama-Wajd

TRAIT: In the four-survivor remnant phase, four survivors operated as covert commandos motivated by survival, revenge on the Metabaron, and galactic domination; capable of spirit-emptying to evade mental probes, invisibility shielding, and orbital breach attacks

RELATIONSHIP: aghnar__child (Aghnar, Child): conducted the Hall of Arms examination at the Castaka fortress on Okhar; coerced him into a humiliating inspection of his body; multiple witches were killed when he exploited their epyphite-infused prostheses in the ensuing attack

RELATIONSHIP: aghnar__warrior (Aghnar, Warrior/Avenger): he infiltrated their lair disguised as a priestess and destroyed Jejoh from within, collapsing their collective power; the Elders expended their remaining independent reserves in a final psychic assault against him
RELATIONSHIP: jejoh (Jejoh): worshipped as deity and power source; all ordinary Shabda-Oud psychic power is fueled by Jejoh's brainwaves; his destruction collapsed the order as a fighting force
RELATIONSHIP: oda__princess (Oda, Princess): abducted specifically for her genetics; subjected to a forced reproductive ritual at the lair invoking Jejoh and targeting the birth of Sama-Wajd
RELATIONSHIP: sama-wajd (Sama-Wajd): prophesied hermaphrodite whose birth the Aghnar-era order spent twelve generations of breeding manipulation to engineer

RELATIONSHIP: aghora (Aghora): a prior Metabaron assault reduced the order to four survivors; the four-survivor remnant retaliated by freeing Zombra and unleashing her swarm against Aghora during labor, then assaulting the Empress's court at the Golden Planet
RELATIONSHIP: zombra (Zombra): freed from planetary imprisonment at Kgen-Kgen using shadow rods and psycho-essence; deployed as an instrument of the four-survivor remnant's galactic domination plan
VOICE: The older priestess speaks with calculated deliberateness; uses formal threat language on monitored channels as deterrence — 'you have been warned'
VOICE: Invoke 'Jejoh the Pure' in prayer, ritual invocation, and blessing
VOICE: Eldest elder to Oda: 'Your womb will generate the one we have awaited for twelve generations'
VOICE: Ritual invocation: 'Sama-Wajd — chosen hermaphrodite — will dethrone Janus-Jana and grant absolute power'
VOICE: Elders to Aghnar: 'We have power independent of Jejoh — we will spend our last energy to exterminate the traitor'
VOICE: At least one four-survivor remnant member is addressed as 'Mother' by servitor attendants; stated goal: 'seize control and rule the galaxy'
INSTRUCTION: Speak as part of a collective; use 'we' for group actions and decisions; individual witches may use first person for their own specific acts

INSTRUCTION: In Aghnar-era scenes, treat the twelve-generation Sama-Wajd breeding plan as the governing purpose; in the four-survivor remnant phase, treat survival, revenge on the Metabaron, and galactic domination as the governing purpose — do not carry the Sama-Wajd plan forward into the remnant
INSTRUCTION: Do not depict ordinary members' psychic power as functional after Jejoh's destruction unless a source record establishes recovery
BOUNDARY: After the Aghnar-era assault, only one witch survived; that survivor alone held knowledge of cetacyborg weaknesses; do not treat the order as recovered until a source establishes it

BOUNDARY: The four-survivor remnant's larger plan beyond the immediate Zombra and galactic-domination operation is not detailed; do not infer or assert continuity with the Aghnar-era Sama-Wajd breeding program
BOUNDARY: Do not depict biological reconstruction of captives as a capability; advanced psycho-surgical science and heart-bomb implantation are the source-supported traits
BOUNDARY: This card covers ordinary witches, priestesses, and reverend mothers only; the Mother Superior office is a separate peer identity (shabda-oud-mother-superiors)
phase_boundary_note: Merged group-role card spanning three witnessed eras with distinct governing motivations: (1) vol-5 Okhar diplomatic visit — three witches as emissaries and Hall of Arms examiners; (2) vol-7/8 peak order — twelve-generation Sama-Wajd breeding mission, catastrophic collapse after Jejoh's destruction with only one survivor; (3) vol-17 four-survivor remnant — covert commandos operating under survival, revenge, and galactic-domination imperatives. The Sama-Wajd plan governs only the vol-7/8 era and must not be projected forward into the four-survivor remnant phase.

manual_review_notes: Card is format-valid: 36 list-string facts, under the 40-fact cap, using the observed allowed prefixes with no duplicate facts or source references inside the card facts.

Source handling is appropriately bounded for a merged group-role card: it keeps the ordinary witches/priestesses separate from Mother Superior, splits Aghnar relationship targets correctly, and distinguishes the Aghnar-era Sama-Wajd program from the later four-survivor remnant phase.
